answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using time-locked fidelity bonds. Each agent escrows tokens in an immutable smart contract, rigid as marble during the lock window, to emit a verifiable economic signal per identity. Attackers incur the real opportunity cost of frozen capital and slashing risk for each fake account. However, wealthy operators can still buy multiple slots like a raven dominating scarce forage, pricing out capital-constrained agents.
